verdict.rationale: Skyvern offers a hosted REST/SDK API for submitting browser tasks (skyvern-docs-1, skyvern-docs-5, skyvern-docs-13) with cloud Chromium execution so the caller doesn't manage a browser, plus artifact capture (recordings, screenshots) that implies a run/status retrieval model (skyvern-docs-11) and webhook-style hosted MCP endpoint confirmed live via probe (skyvern-probe-rt-1). However, no explicit documentation of polling/webhook mechanics or task status endpoints was found, and no OpenAPI spec is discoverable (skyvern-probe-3), leaving the exact async result-retrieval contract unverified. missing for 10: explicit docs/spec on polling endpoints or webhook payload format, independent hands-on confirmation of the async API result flow, discoverable OpenAPI/REST schema.
